name: Óbuda University
summary: Budapest technical and business university: eight of its 16 BSc degrees are taught entirely in English, each seven semesters.

ib.text: No IB points rule: upload your Diploma and a report card showing Maths, Physics and English. English B2 (IELTS 5.5) is waived if your schooling was fully in English. Online entrance tests follow.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Management
programmes.about: Trains economists to understand, plan and analyse how business organisations run, with specialisations in Digital Manager or Project Management and B2B Marketing; includes a work placement (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test after your documents are checked, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Commerce and Marketing
programmes.about: Economics and business knowledge with commerce and marketing skills for selling products and services and running commercial activity in small and medium firms (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test after your documents are checked, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Computer Science Engineering
programmes.about: Programming, software engineering, databases, networks and security, with a specialisation in Cloud Service Technologies and IT Security from semester four (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online test in Maths plus Physics or Informatics, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Electrical engineering with natural sciences, economics and humanities, and specialisations in automation, communication technologies, embedded systems or energy (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths and Physics tests, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Engineering Management
programmes.about: Engineering managers with natural and technical science, economics and organisation skills for production and service work, with specialisations in project or corporate management (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test after your documents are checked, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Environmental Engineering
programmes.about: Applied natural sciences, ecology, technology and management for preventing and cleaning up pollution and using resources well; specialisations in energy, green energy and land, or water (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test plus one of Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Informatics. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Industrial Design Engineering
programmes.about: Engineers who design, make and market industrial products, with product design (interior, textile, fashion accessories) or packaging specialisations; combines technology, aesthetics and economics (210 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Drawing portfolio as one PDF: a geometric-bodies drawing, a drapery study and free drawings or designs.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test plus one of Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Informatics, and a drawing portfolio. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Mechatronical Engineering
programmes.about: Mechanical engineering, electronics and computer control together, for designing and running mechatronic devices and smart machines; robotics or intelligent control specialisation (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths and Physics tests, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: EU/EEA applicants pay EUR 2,000 a semester for every BSc, against EUR 2,700 to 3,200 for non-EEA applicants; there is also a EUR 150 application fee.
Every school-leaving document needs a notarised English translation, even when the original is in English.
Applicants must be 18 by the start of the study period; if you are still in your final school year, upload the school-leaving certificate by 1 August.
